Scenario fixture: identical-iframes-same-purpose (WCAG 4.1.2)

The rule compares frames that share an accessible name. Each case uses its own name, so frames from different cases never form a set. Targets have ids of the form iisp_case_NN_a and iisp_case_NN_b. Frames that load different resources are asked about, never failed: different resources can still serve the same purpose.

A. Same resource (PASS)

01 — PASS: two frames named "Weather" load the same page
02 — PASS: same name through title and aria-label, same page
03 — PASS: the addresses differ only by a fragment

B. Different resources (CANTTELL)

04 — CANTTELL: two frames named "Contributors" load different pages
05 — CANTTELL: one frame has no src, so its resource cannot be compared

C. No set (NOT APPLICABLE)

06 — NOT APPLICABLE: the two frames have different names
07 — NOT APPLICABLE: one of the two frames is hidden with aria-hidden="true"
